goal: Operator can search pending orders, bind a resolved device, and ship through a safe backend workflow.
stop_condition: Backend tests pass for ship orchestration, OCR request shape, idempotency, and no-local-mutation failure paths.
non_goals: Do not implement other XianGuanJia write endpoints.
Do not expose OCR credentials or sender/recipient PII to frontends.
Do not mutate the frozen read-only integration change.
expected_evidence: Spec-review and quality-review notes for backend touched files.
unsafe_assumptions: Assuming a searched order is still pending at submit time.
Assuming the courier image contains recipient or sender data that should be stored.
Assuming write-enabled configuration is safe by default.
